farm_sub: Fill in your farm and Soil Health Card once. Every other screen uses it.
crops_sub: Scores weigh your soil, pH, water, temperature and nutrients against what each crop needs.
fert_sub: Doses are adjusted to your Soil Health Card: 25% more where a nutrient is low, 25% less where it is high.
pest_lead: What is wrong with my crop?
pest_sub: Pick your crop and the signs you see in the field. A leaf photo can tick some signs for you.
noSigns: Tick at least one sign to check your crop.
noMatch: No close match for this crop. Send a photo to an expert.
safety: Wear gloves and a mask while spraying. Follow the dose on the product label and check with your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
photoHint: Choose a clear photo of one leaf against a plain background
photoNote: This is a colour screen, not a trained disease model. It adds the matching signs above so you can confirm them.
weather_sub: 7-day outlook with a water plan for {{c}}, worked out from crop water use and expected rain.
howCalc: How this works: daily crop water use = crop factor × reference evaporation (Hargreaves). We subtract 80% of rain and suggest watering when the soil has lost its safe limit for your soil type.
simW: Simulated forecast for the demo. In production this connects to the IMD district forecast.
mandi_lead: {{c}} is fetching the best price at {{m}}: ₹{{p}}/quintal
mandi_sub: Prices across nearby markets for the last 30 days.
simM: Sample prices for the demo. In production these come from Agmarknet / eNAM.
expert_sub: Questions go to the block extension officer, who can reply and send alerts to all farmers in the district.
name: Your name
question: Your question
alertPh: e.g. Fall armyworm seen in maize near Katol. Check whorls this week.
fillAll: Fill in your name and question.
noQ: No questions yet. Ask the first one.
ps_overview: Recommendations for this week, based on your farm profile.
ps_profile: Location, soil and water details. Every recommendation is calculated from these values.
ps_planner: Crops that fit this season, ranked by how well they suit your field.
ps_nutrients: Fertiliser quantities and timing, adjusted to your Soil Health Card.
ps_health: Identify likely pests and diseases from field symptoms or a leaf photo.
ps_weather: Seven-day outlook with an irrigation and spraying schedule.
ps_market: Prices across nearby mandis, compared with MSP.
ps_desk: Questions from farmers and alerts from extension officers.
kpi_none_m: Soil moisture is adequate for 7 days
kpi_field: Urea, DAP and MOP for {{a}} acres
ch_suit_sub: Score out of 100 for crops that fit this season
noAlerts: No active alerts for this district.
